description: The reports in the vault's reports/ folder, drawn by longbook from the confirmed charges it holds: those dated today or earlier whose basis is anything but "plan". A report may cover any span of days — longbook draws every calendar month on its own; a trip is one whose id starts "trip-"; a span asked for with create_report starts "report-" — and may be narrowed to accounts, members and categories (scope; absent means all). A report still holding unconfirmed passed charges in its currency says so in its own figures — a "Not yet confirmed" stat counts them beside "Total expenses" — so read the total as the part longbook can account for, never as the span's spending. delta_pct is absent whenever no change can honestly be drawn: the month is not over, either month is part-covered, or the month before holds no confirmed spending in this currency. Read its absence as "longbook would not say", never as a month of no spending, and never compute the change from two reports. Without an id it lists them, newest first by the last day each covers: the title, start_date and end_date, the scope, the month when it is one, the day the file was written, how many modules it holds and how many comments sit on them, and the share link when one is live. With an id it returns that report whole — every module exactly as the app draws it, each with its own comments. A module carries "Total expenses", "Accounts", "Categories" and "All charges"; an older file may hold other kinds, and they are returned as they are. A file the app's own decoder would refuse is counted in unreadable, never listed as a report — what this lists is what the Reports screen shows. Comments are the owner's and their viewers' own words: quote them, never rewrite them. An id that matches more than one report answers with the matches, not with a guess. Reports are files, so this reads only on the owner's own machine.
name: reports
title: Read reports
